data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French word ‘florètte’ meaning ‘little flower’. This name has been used in literature, music, and art, symbolizing beauty, grace, and delicate charm. The name Florette carries the meaning “Little flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Florette usually hope their child will grow to embody little flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
